metadata.title: Solutions of $x^α+y^α=1$ in $λ$-Cantor sets
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the structure of the solutions of $x^\alpha+y^\alpha=1$ with both coordinates in a $\lambda$-Cantor set. We prove that, for any $\alpha>1$, the intersection with the middle-third Cantor set has positive Hausdorff dimension, strengthening the infinitude question posed by Jiang et al. [J. London Math. Soc. 113 (2026), e70408]. To explore the structure of the solutions, for arbitrary $\alpha$, we find that their Hausdorff dimension undergoes phase transitions as $\lambda$ varies: we establish the occurrence of Hausdorff phase transitions by proving the existence of zero-dimensional and positive-dimensional regions.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 研究坐标同属 λ-Cantor 集的方程 x^α+y^α=1 的解集及其 Hausdorff 维数。
analysis.breakthrough: 对每个 α>1，证明中三分 Cantor 集中的解集具有正 Hausdorff 维数，将原有无限性问题加强为定量维数结论。
analysis.limitations: 随 λ 的相变通过零维与正维区域的存在建立；摘要未给出每一参数的完整维数公式。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对经典分形上的代数关系提供强于存在性的新结论。
